source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: the R8T2 run of the port's test steps and the C3A4 unit test; and the SXH4 bench runs on the same unit (2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25); and the solo bench run of SLH4 on the same unit (2026-10-25)
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74: in R8T2 (2026-10-18) slice-loop's test passes: on an empty sound track, FUNC + CHRO > SLICE LOOP shows LOOP SLICED and places 16 trigs, and choosing it again shows TRACK NOT EMPTY. In C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports, 2026-10-20) each mod's own test passed, including this one's. On SXH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 with the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions, 2026-10-24) SLICE LOOP showed LOOP SLICED and then TRACK NOT EMPTY, and a four-minute play showed no freeze or dropout. Alone on SLH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 and this module only, 2026-10-25) SLICE LOOP showed LOOP SLICED and then TRACK NOT EMPTY without changing the pattern again.
scope: slice-loop 1.0 beside other rytm2_mods ports. SXH4 ran it with the released core-ar2 0.3 and the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions. SLH4 ran it alone with the released core-ar2 0.3.

builds.label: SLH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and this module's rytm2_mods v1.2 release object as the only module, plus the remote-control test layer (analoghealth 1.2, no site shared with core or the module). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after the run.
results: Alone: SLICE LOOP showed LOOP SLICED, then TRACK NOT EMPTY with the pattern unchanged (screens, pattern memory).
No freeze or dropout on any output.

builds.label: SXH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and rytm2_mods v1.2's release objects for the six Modwerk 1.74 submissions, plus a remote-control test layer (three sites, none shared with core or the modules). Without the test layer the same inputs give SX74 (2a352718de044cdba51a2b8a3a064ef126d79ab54f24ac7a7662f6c686e64371). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after each run.
results: SXH4: SLICE LOOP showed LOOP SLICED, then TRACK NOT EMPTY (screens).

Four minutes of play with samples, delay and reverb sends and knob turns: no freeze, gap or level dip on any output; clicks on the main mix also appear on the same core and test layer without the modules.

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153, and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
results: Each mod's own test passed, including Slice Loop's.

builds.label: R8T2
builds.content: core-ar2 0.1 ported to 1.74 with filter-hz, ctrl-all 1.1, env-reset-amp, slice-loop, main-rms, lfo-rnd, comp-preview and kit-ab. slice-loop's OS 1.74 source is the same file as in v1.2.
results: Step 8: on an empty sound track, FUNC + CHRO > SLICE LOOP shows LOOP SLICED and places 16 trigs; choosing it again shows TRACK NOT EMPTY.
